course_name: Proceed with English - 9th Year Basic Education
source: Ministry of Education - National Pedagogic Centre, Tunisia
pedagogical_principles: Learner-Centered Approach: Student is an active user of English at the core of the learning process
Constructiveness: Teaching based on learner's active construction and higher-level knowledge structures
Cooperativeness: Collaborative learning in groups, sharing knowledge
Contextuality: Language as communication, not decontextualized grammar

modules.theme: Family relationships, responsibilities, generation gap, pocket money, safety at home
modules.project: Multi-step project about school problems (fashion through generations)

objectives: Enable students to talk about family relationships and realize family life is not always happy
key_structures: Describing using long and short adjectives
activities: Read three texts about different family relationships

objectives: Listen to passage to compare different types of family roles and share opinions
subskills: Draw on background knowledge to understand text
activities: Listen to passage about modern father (Mark) sharing family responsibilities

objectives: Enable students to read about and react to family issues
subskills: Produce text from various sources of information
activities: Read about Jane's problems with parents
Discuss fashion as source of conflict

objectives: Read passage about pocket money to discuss its importance and write paragraph
subskills: Write to recycle structures covered in class
activities: Read parents' opinions on pocket money

objectives: Read about and discuss safety at home, write using appropriate language
activities: Read about risks pets might represent

modules.theme: School memories, rules, first day, violence, school life

objectives: Recycle language about school life, prepare for reading passage, start project about school problems
key_structures: Using the genitive to express possession
activities: Read about three types of family relationships and cheating

objectives: Listen to, complete, and comprehend poem about school rules
grammar_points: Present progressive + future word = planned action
key_structures: Using present progressive for planned future actions
activities: Listen to poem about daydreaming student (Mike)
Practice different ways of talking about future events

objectives: Revise simple past by reading about girl's school memories
grammar_points: Simple past (express completed action in the past)
key_structures: Using simple past for completed actions
subskills: Recognize basic syntactic patterns and devices
activities: Read about first day at school
lessons.pronunciation: Word stress 3 - Nouns & adjectives / e / / æ /

objectives: Enable pupils to speak about violence in schools
grammar_points: Prepositions: Location (over, next to), Movement (along, across)
key_structures: Using prepositions of location and movement
subskills: Work in groups and share information to perform oral task
activities: Talk about prohibited and desired activities at school
Read conversation between Jill and Kelly about verbal and physical violence

objectives: Read about aspect of school life and react to it
key_structures: Using future tense for expressing intention
subskills: Share information to perform oral task and solve problem
activities: Brainstorm vocabulary related to school life
Read Kate's letter and discuss her problems

modules.theme: Pollution, smoking, environmental threats, conservation, Earth Day
modules.project: Multi-step project creating environmental awareness materials

objectives: Enable students to talk about pollution and its effects on people and environment
key_structures: Using linkers to sequence events and show cause and effect
subskills: Work in pairs/small groups to understand text
activities: Discuss types of pollution and effects on people
Read four short texts about pollution

objectives: Listen and read about harmful effects of smoking on health
subskills: Draw on background knowledge to understand text
activities: Use pictures to talk about smoking topic
Listen to Susan's father talking about smoking

lessons.lesson_title: Pollution, A Threat to Our Environment
objectives: Enable pupils to talk about effects of pollution and suggest solutions
grammar_points: Who, Which, That (defining people and objects)
key_structures: Using relative pronouns to define people and objects
subskills: Use free writing to develop fluency
activities: Think of ways to take active part in improving environment

objectives: Enable pupils to talk about measures to prevent environmental damage
grammar_points: Should, Ought to, Must, Don't... (giving advice, obligation, prohibition)
key_structures: Using modal verbs for advice, obligation, and prohibition
subskills: Identify/select main idea, supporting details, facts
Write to recycle structures covered in class
activities: Build sentences about preventing environmental damage
Read poem (elephant complaining about man's wickedness)

lessons.lesson_title: Let Everyday Be an Earth Day
objectives: Have pupils speak, read and write about health and environment
grammar_points: Compound nouns: Noun + Noun, Gerund + Noun, Noun + Gerund (noun formation 2)
key_structures: Forming compound nouns using different patterns
activities: Suggest solutions for damage to environment and health
Link food items to health effects
Write short paragraph about importance of healthy environment

modules.theme: Airport services, internet shopping, tourism, transport, communication
modules.project: Create blog about services (digital or paper version)

objectives: Enable students to talk and read about services, particularly at airports
grammar_points: Would you mind + v + ing (making polite requests)
Could you + VP (requesting others to do something)
key_structures: Making polite requests using 'would you mind'
subskills: Infer emotional state of speaker (from intonation, speech rate)
activities: Identify places where services are provided
Speak about services provided by post-office
Read conversation between flight attendant and passenger
Project Work: Step 1 - Create blog (with computer teacher's help)

objectives: Enable students to listen to and understand passage about internet shopping
subskills: Listen to infer meaning of new words/expressions
activities: Listen to passage about internet shopping
Writing about tourism (paves way for Lesson 3)

objectives: Have pupils read and discuss importance of tourism in Tunisia
grammar_points: That will be / It's very nice / kind of you
subskills: Use free writing to develop fluency
activities: Use visuals to discuss Tunisia as tourist country
Contrast present perfect with simple past
Project Work: Step 2 - Work on mobile phone uses for blog

objectives: Enable students to speak and write about different means of transport
key_structures: Using first conditional for real future conditions
subskills: Predict gist and type of text from illustrations
Reinvest covered language in project work
activities: Talk about different means of transport
Write paragraph about differences between means of transport using linkers

objectives: Enable pupils to read and write about telephone and its uses in everyday life
subskills: Work in pairs and share information to perform oral task
activities: Discuss different shapes of phone and uses

modules.theme: Means of entertainment, eating out, tourism activities, films, stars' pastimes
modules.project: Create wall display about favorite song and singer

objectives: Introduce topic of entertainment, enable pupils to read and express themselves about it
grammar_points: I'm sure + that clause / No doubt + declarative sentence (expressing certainty)
activities: Read what five people say about entertainment likes/dislikes
Project Work: Step 1 - Collect information about favorite song and singer

objectives: Provide pupils with language to understand listening passage about ordering food
grammar_points: It's a surprise, What a..., How nice + to (exclamations)
This is just what I wanted / needed / meant (expressing satisfaction)
activities: Complete spidergram about eating out vocabulary
Listen to conversation about ordering in restaurant
Express surprise and dissatisfaction in writing

objectives: Teach pupils to speak about places they like to go to and make suggestions
activities: Look at pictures of entertainment activities
Focus on verb form in suggestions

objectives: Enable students to talk about films, read and speak about cartoon star
grammar_points: I'm so / very sorry + that clause (expressing regret)
activities: Focus on Nemo regretting disobeying father
Complete gapped poem/song written by Nemo

objectives: Enable students to speak and write about stars and their pastimes
grammar_points: I'd like to know more about... (showing interest)
It sounds interesting, I'm interested in...
activities: Read and speak about stars' pastimes
Write expressing interest or indifference about events

modules.theme: Voluntary work, volunteering kids, cooperation, clubs/associations, tolerance
modules.project: Multi-step project about helping elderly people

objectives: Raise pupils' awareness about voluntary work, enable them to read, talk and write about it
activities: Speak about voluntary work through visuals
Read four short texts where people describe helping others
Project Work: Step 1 - Suggest visit to elderly house

objectives: Help pupils learn about volunteering kids and active participation in civil society
grammar_points: What can I do for you?
subskills: Listen to identify, understand and react to social issues
activities: Label pictures showing what kids can do
Listen to Melissa explain F.A.C.E organisation
Discuss how kids can help environment
Explain how poor people can be helped by kids

objectives: Teach pupils about benefits of cooperation and collaborative work
key_structures: Using past progressive for ongoing past actions
subskills: Predict gist and type of text from format, illustrations, title
Infer possible meanings of grammar structure
activities: Read text about cooperation at school
Learn past progressive used with simple past
Focus on tenses and their use

objectives: Enable students to speak and write about associations/charities and their role in society
grammar_points: I think that..., I believe that... (expressing opinion)
In my opinion..., I think so...
activities: Look at pictures and speak about activities to help others
Think of other possible ways to help people
Read texts where teenagers express opinions about clubs/organisations
Write about Lady Diana's biography (focus on charity work)
lessons.pronunciation: Spelling 5 - Spelling of verbs ending in 'o'

objectives: Enable pupils to read and write about tolerance and respect for others
activities: Speak about issues related to topic
Discuss differences between people and resulting problems (racism, loneliness, exclusion)
Read about Nicole Evans and Ibrahim (young people promoting peace)

grammar_overview: Can I help you?, What can I do for you?
I think that..., I believe that..., In my opinion...
reading_strategies: Predict outcomes and content from titles and illustrations
Skim text to get main ideas
Work in pairs/small groups to understand texts
Identify main ideas and supporting details
listening_strategies: Infer emotional state from intonation and speech rate
Infer meaning of new words/expressions from context
speaking_strategies: Work in pairs and small groups
Share information to perform oral tasks
pronunciation_focus: Mute consonants: b, w, k, l, gh, g, h, t, p, s
Word stress in nouns, verbs, adjectives, compounds
Vowel sounds: / u / / u: /, / i / / i: / / ai /, / ei / / ou / / au /, / ɔ: i / / i: ə /
Diphthongs: / ai / / aiə /, / au∂ / / ai∂ /, / ou/ /ei /
Spelling patterns: noun plurals (Y → ies), double consonants, 'ing' forms

reading: Work in groups to understand texts
speaking: Work in pairs and small groups

communication_skills: Make polite requests and offer help
Describe past, present, and future actions
language_competence: Use variety of verb tenses appropriately

students_book: Get Ready: Topic introduction through pictures, brainstorming, background knowledge
Learn More About It: Reading/listening passages, poems, conversations with comprehension questions
The Grammar Point: Grammar structures from reading/listening material, contextualized learning
activity_book: Comprehension Check: Further comprehension and written expression
Language Work: Grammar and vocabulary practice through writing
Writing and/or Project Work: Multi-step tasks requiring cooperation
The Lighter Side/Grandma's Corner: Relaxation activities

target_audience: 9th year basic education students in Tunisian preparatory schools
